messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Ace Editor in Shiny
parts:
I'm working on a package that may be of interest to this community: shinyAce.

The goal of the package is to enable Shiny applications to take advantage of the Ace editor (the same editor used in the RStudio IDE). For the uninitiated, Ace offers a variety of themes and "modes" (languages). You can sample these modes and themes in this Shiny example. shinyAce supports all of the modes and themes that Ace provides. 

Eventually, I hope to setup examples (and integrations) to do Markdown and R code evaluation in this package. (If you can't wait, you can always checkout the example Yihui Xie put together or the hosted OpenCPU application. Such functionality will eventually be facilitated within this package.)
